items.title: US Air Force wants AI to assist aerial refueling
items.summary: The goal is for AI to automatically analyze refueling operations from cameras mounted on the tankers and provide “hot wash” feedback to the tanker crews.

items.title: Navy officer convicted of pushing his wife out of window to her death petitions Supreme Court for review
items.summary: Navy Lt. Craig Becker's attorney is petitioning the Supreme Court for review, arguing key evidence was omitted from the trial.

items.title: Leonardo, Rheinmetall secure $4 billion contracts with Italian Army, report says
items.summary: The defense companies secured two contracts with the Italian Army for $4.16 billion for armored vehicles, an Italian financial newspaper reported.

items.title: White House military spouse council floats toll cuts for troops commuting to base
items.summary: The council said recent toll cuts at MacDill Air Force Base in Tampa, Florida, should be used as a “template” for other bases across the U.S. The post White House military spouse council floats toll cuts for troops commuting to base appeared first on Task & Purpose.

items.title: Why Caribbean Threats Cascade Into Global Cyber-Risk
items.summary: The region is demonstrating what happens when exploits accelerate but assurance does not.

items.title: Saudi missile plant expansion may produce more powerful missiles, study says
items.summary: More capable missiles could help Saudi Arabia deter Iranian attacks and make its military more self-reliant, but they risk fueling a regional missile race.

items.title: Military takeover of New Mexico borderlands challenged in court
items.summary: The lawsuit argues that the government unlawfully expanded the scope and duration of its “national defense area” designation.
